name: Fill the Spot
idea: When a teammate cuts away, slide over and fill the empty spot.
why: Five players spread around the arc are hard to guard. If everyone fills the empty spots, the defense can never bunch up.
tryit: Play pass and cut with five players. Every time someone cuts, call out the spot you fill: “Top!” “Wing!” “Corner!”

frames.say: Five spots around the arc, one player in each. {1} has the ball at the top.
*Cut:* {1} cuts to the basket. Now the top spot is empty!
*Fill the spot:* Everyone on that side slides over one spot. {3} fills the top, {5} the wing, and {1} the corner.
{2} swings the ball to {3} at the top. {X3} is still running to catch up!
Swish! When a teammate leaves a spot, fill it. That keeps the court spread out.
